Field Descriptions

LIMIT

APT proportion threshold for 2-bit samples. Maximum allowed count of most common 2-bit pattern in a 256-sample window. For unbiased source, expect ~64 (25%). Default=128 allows up to 50%. Reduce to ~75-85 to detect 2-bit pattern bias. Test fails if pattern count exceeds this limit.
